mechanism: CSymbolMetaCache prefetches static SymbolInfo contract fields and session windows once, serves IsMarketOpen from in-memory comparisons, Refresh at midnight; no market feature is sensed.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multi-symbol demo (EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, AUDUSD, USDCAD); benchmark across ~20 Market Watch symbols.
why_new_for_mis: Terminal lookup infrastructure only — caching point/lot/session metadata is not MIS sensing.
quote: What is missing is a layer between the EA's per-tick logic and the terminal's SymbolInfo API: something that fetches each monitored symbol's static contract specification and session schedule exactly once

mechanism: Reconstructs closed trades from DEAL_ENTRY_IN/OUT by position_id, two-pass SL/TP fallback to ORDER_SL/TP, serializes R-multiple/pip profit/duration to JSON; export tooling, not a market sensor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Example EURUSD closed trades; date-range HistorySelect filter.
quote: produce a programmatically readable report of closed trades (not raw deals) for a user-specified date range... written as a single JSON document

mechanism: Aggregate Black-Scholes gamma×OI×multiplier×spot²×0.01 per strike with dealer sign (calls +, puts −); SolveFlip sweeps assumed spot through DealerGammaAtSpot and interpolates the zero crossing; spot above flip → net long gamma (mean-reverting), below → short gamma (trending).
data_needed: Option chain (CSV or native MT5 options): strike, right, expiry, mid, spot, rate, OI; IV via server or Newton-bisection ImpliedVol; single nearest future expiry.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Synthetic index spot 5000 sample chain (strikes 4500–5500); native path via SYMBOL_BASIS options; daily-use chart overlay.
why_new_for_mis: Maps dealer hedging into an explicit mean-reversion vs trend regime gauge from options positioning — MIS can gate fade/chase modules by spot vs flip without price-only oscillators.
quote: Above the flip the aggregate dealer position is typically long gamma, so the regime is mean-reverting and moves get faded; below it the position flips short, so the regime is trending and moves get chased.

mechanism: Per-strike signed dollar-GEX profile; call wall = strike of largest positive dealer GEX (ceiling via intensified dealer selling), put wall = most-negative GEX (floor); net GEX is the headline regime number drawn with walls/flip on chart.
data_needed: Same chain/OI as GEX profile; contract multiplier (default 100); single-expiry Build.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Sample: put wall 4800, call wall 5200, flip near 5000; US equity-style options or CSV chain.
why_new_for_mis: OI-weighted gamma concentration levels as structural liquidity magnets — MIS can sense where dealer hedging is expected to absorb vs amplify flow.
quote: the strike with the largest positive exposure (the call wall, which tends to act as a ceiling because dealer selling intensifies there) and the strike with the largest negative exposure (the put wall, a floor for the mirror reason).

mechanism: OnTick read PositionsTotal → build self-refreshing HTML via setInterval location.reload; UI export of tickets/P&L, not market sensing.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any open account positions (examples EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY).
quote: On every tick, the EA reads all currently open positions, builds a styled HTML page in memory, and writes that page to a file inside MQL5/Files/.

mechanism: CTDAMapperFilter maps each Takens-embedded price point to one scalar: eccentricity = mean pairwise distance (rim high), density = Σ exp(-d²/(2σ²)) Gaussian KDE (crowded high), or coordinate projection; CTDAMapperCover slices [min,max] into overlapping intervals (resolution, gain) with CSR membership — foundation for Mapper graph regime shape.
data_needed: CTDAPointCloud + CTDADistance matrix; N points (demo ~40); densitySigmaFrac (0.3); cover resolution ~5–15, gain ~0.2–0.5.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Cosine delay-embedding circle demo; notes real close windows lose symmetry so intrinsic lenses carry information.
why_new_for_mis: Intrinsic geometric summaries of a price point cloud (centrality vs crowding) give MIS a topology-ready shape sensor before clustering — eccentricity separates calm center from trend extremes, density marks linger levels.
quote: The eccentricity lens separates the calm center of a range from the extremes of a trend leg. The density lens picks out the levels where price lingered.

mechanism: OnTrade deal-count delta → parameterized INSERT into trade_events via Database* API; persistence/logging infra, not sensing.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Logged examples EURUSD, AUDJPY, XAUUSD, etc. from live deal history.
quote: On each OnTrade() callback, the EA detects deals that arrived since the previous call. It builds a structured record for each deal and inserts it into the trade_events table

mechanism: From aligned closes → simple returns → sample cov/corr; d=√(0.5*(1−corr)); single-linkage AHC tree; quasi-diagonal leaf order; recursive bisection α=1−v0/(v0+v1) by inverse-variance cluster risk — discovers co-movement families without inverting cov.
data_needed: Price panel [nBars×nAssets] time-aligned across symbols; lookback bars; ALGLIB Clusterizer single linkage.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Basket e.g. EURUSD,GBPUSD,USDJPY,XAUUSD,US500; stress 21-symbol vs Markowitz; hourly bars example; InpTF rebalance cadence.
why_new_for_mis: Online-ready multi-asset correlation structure tree — MIS can sense which instruments currently form redundant risk families and when the dendrogram regroups after a correlation shock.
quote: Instead of treating all the instruments as one pool to optimize over, it first uncovers the structure already sitting in the data: which instruments behave alike, and how they group into families.

mechanism: OnTradeTransaction enqueues TRADE_OPEN/CLOSE JSON; OnTimer drains via WinINet PostJson with outage-aware logging; event transport, not market sensing.
quote: A small in-memory queue decouples the trade callback from the delivery attempt, so OnTradeTransaction() always returns immediately

mechanism: CExecutionGateway normalizes lots, widens SL/TP to stops level, resolves filling mode, retries REQUOTE/TIMEOUT/PRICE_CHANGED, checks slippage; execution plumbing, not sensing.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Demo GatewayEA on chart symbol (EURUSD constraints in tests).
quote: strategy logic decides what to trade, and the gateway decides how that decision reaches the broker safely.

mechanism: Closed-bar three-candle FVG: bull Low(Bar1)>High(Bar3), bear High(Bar1)<Low(Bar3); zone top/bottom/midpoint; keep only if gap height ≥ SimpleTR_avg(period)×multiplier; mitigate by wick-touch or close-through; return latest unmitigated zone.
data_needed: CopyRates OHLC; TR period (default 14), multiplier (0.5); mitigation mode 0/1; shift≥1; max_bars scan depth.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M5 Strategy Tester Jan 2024–Dec 2025; PERIOD_CURRENT chart symbol.
why_new_for_mis: Auction-theory liquidity-void sensor with explicit volatility noise gate and mitigation lifecycle — MIS can mark unfilled imbalance zones as structural rebalance magnets complementary to GEX walls.
quote: The engine records an FVG only if its height meets the volatility threshold: FVG Height (Top - Bottom) >= Simple_TR_Average(Period) * Multiplier

mechanism: Level-2 path signature via Chen update S2+=S1*δ+0.5*δi*δj then S1+=δ; LevyArea(i,j)=0.5*(S2[i,j]−S2[j,i]) on min-max-normalized two-channel window (price-volume, two symbols time-aligned, or time-value); optional Flint-Hambly-Lyons staircase; zero-line / threshold cross marks lead flip.
data_needed: Rolling window closes (and tick volume or second-symbol closes); N≈40–100; normalize on; modes PAIR/LEADLAG/TIMEVALUE; shuffle residual self-check.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 price vs tick volume; EURUSD vs GBPUSD H1 two-symbol; window 60; Levy threshold 0.02.
why_new_for_mis: Lag-free nonlinear ordering sensor that detects who leads whom and when that ordering flips — MIS gets a per-window lead-lag change feature classical cross-correlation needs a lag scan to approximate.
quote: If you can read which series is ahead right now, and catch the instant that ordering flips, you have a signal that classical momentum and correlation both miss.

mechanism: CSigLeadLag.GetFeatures packs fixed-length [S1[0], S1[1], S2[0][1], S2[1][0], LevyArea] from any window length — ready sequence/path feature vector for logistic or ONNX heads; EA pairs Levy threshold cross with Level1 price-sign agreement.
data_needed: Same signed window as Levy engine; closed bars only (shift 1..W).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; optional second symbol; feature vector dimension 5 independent of N.
why_new_for_mis: Rough-path feature machine inside MT5 — MIS can feed a compact path-shape vector (order-sensitive, reparametrization-invariant) into neural/sequence sensors without guessing lag k.
quote: The signature is not a single indicator; it is a small feature machine. The Levy area is the first term worth reading, and the same engine gives a fixed-length vector a model can learn from

mechanism: CASEstimators ring buffer of mid increments: sigma=√(E[d²]−E[d]²); k=1/mean(|Δ|) as MLE decay for λ(d)=A·exp(−k·d) proxy from move-size distribution; feeds AS optimal spread γ·σ²·(T−t)+(2/γ)·ln(1+γ/k).
data_needed: Rolling mid (bar close or tick mid); window capacity; gamma; horizon timeLeft in bars.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 5000-bar sim; indicator live mid from bid/ask; typical σ≈0.00069, k≈2004.
why_new_for_mis: Joint live vol + liquidity-intensity sensor — MIS can widen/tighten risk bands when σ rises or k falls (violent tape) without needing L2 book fills.
quote: A market that moves in small steps has a large k and a tight spread; a market that lurches has a small k and a wide one.

mechanism: r=mid−q·γ·σ²·(T−t); bid/ask straddle r not mid so long inventory pulls fair price down (ask closer, bid farther); skew=r−mid plotted as inventory-control state of a two-sided quote.
data_needed: Signed inventory q (lots), gamma, sigma, timeLeft; mid price.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 fixed vs AS simulation; horizon 600 bars in examples; gamma preference knob.
why_new_for_mis: Turns inventory+vol into an explicit quote-skew sensor for two-sided strategies — MIS can read how hard the book should lean against current position under measured σ.
quote: The price you quote around should not be the mid price. It should be a reservation price, the mid price shifted against your current inventory.
